description: The lifecycle of a procurement procedure from one of its notices: every TED notice of the same procedure in order (prior information, call, corrigenda, award, contract modification), the change events between them (deadline changed, estimated value changed, lots changed, change reasons as published, award published, closed without award) and the resulting state. Each event references the notice that supports it; history before eForms (2023) may hold only one notice. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_history"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/history?id=599727-2026

id.description: TED publication number of any notice of the procedure (required)
